decision: Add DAAX_AGENT_IMAGE_OVERRIDE, an operator env var that wins over the client-supplied agent container image
rationale: The published agent image defaults are digest-pinned in the CLIENT bundle (DEFAULT_AGENT_IMAGE/_GSD in lib/settings.ts) and AI-tool sessions always send an image param from browser localStorage, so CLAUDE_CONTAINER_IMAGE — consulted only when no image is sent — can never move a real session. With the pinned images shipping Claude Code 2.1.197/2.1.201, which default to the retired Opus 4.8 and cannot self-update ('no write permission to npm prefix'), every AI session landed on a dead model and the operator had no server-side lever short of a registry push or every user editing Settings by hand. Verified live: a session requesting the stale -gsd digest is overridden and lands on Claude Code 2.1.233 / Opus 5
alternatives: Change the digest pins in code (rejected: a locally built image has no registry digest, so the pin model requires a push first); repoint CLAUDE_CONTAINER_IMAGE (rejected: it is only a default and is never consulted for AI sessions); tell every user to edit the Settings image field (rejected: not an operator control, and invisible to anyone who does not know)

decision: Resolve the copilot JS entrypoint at run time instead of pinning pnpm's global store version
rationale: buildFullCommand hardcoded .../pnpm/global/5/node_modules/@github/copilot/index.js. pnpm has since moved the global store to 'global/v11', so that path exists in no current agent image and every copilot session failed. Resolution now uses find with a QUOTED pattern — zsh aborts on an unmatched glob and prints 'no matches found' into the user's session — and falls back to the copilot shim on PATH, verified working (GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.68). The JS path is still preferred first because it is the musl workaround the original code existed for
alternatives: Hardcode global/v11 (rejected: re-introduces exactly the same breakage at the next pnpm store bump); drop the JS path and always use the shim (rejected: discards the documented musl workaround without evidence it is obsolete on every image)
